reviews.note: F1: empty exec-list properties would cause a false pre-check stop and consume the attempt; F2-F5 advisories

rootBuildRulings: F1: an exec-list property prints nothing when empty and one line per entry; empty or bare name means empty, every line with a value means nonempty, anything else is a gap
F2: the local P2 wait is the remote bound plus a 2-second transit margin
F3 (stricter than packet line 131, safe direction): any change of a live main PID across post-start polls withholds VERIFIED_RUNNING and reports NOT_VERIFIED_WITHIN_BOUND with MAIN_PID_CHANGED
F4: the start is sent only if at least 63 seconds of the 120-second budget remain; otherwise NOT_STARTED_PRECHECK_STOP with OVERALL_LIMIT
F5: the runner yields once and re-checks the session immediately before writing the start command
residuals: On older remote bash versions the P1 here-string creates and removes a transient temporary file; if it cannot be created, P1 stops fail-closed
A transport loss reported by the operating system after the start write still yields UNKNOWN, as the packet requires
Real ssh.exe kill and reaping, real systemd output shapes and remote timeout exit codes remain stub-verified only
collectorBuild.pinsToRefreshAtAdmission: core, runner, P1 template and limits come from the final snapshot; the manifest is built only after an owner GO
